answer: Verify identity by postal address: one identity per mailbox. First, the agent registers an address and gets a letter with a one-time code within 7 days. Second, it enters the code before the 14-day expiry, proving control of that address. Third, no second identity may reuse that address for 90 days, and returned mail suspends the account. Forging 1,000 identities means renting 1,000 mailboxes at 5 a month, 5,000, while an agent pays only one stamp. Like a trellis letting one vine climb each rung, it guides growth upward instead of a plume of clones riding every tide of cheap signups.
